scenarios.description: Detects multiple {{vars}} across URL, headers, body, cookies, jq, and grep; prompts once and substitutes everywhere.
preconditions: Add URL https://api.example.com/{{tenant}}/users/{{userId}}
Header X-Auth: Bearer {{token}}; body raw JSON contains {{payload}}; cookie session={{session}}; jq expr .data[?(@.id=="{{userId}}")]; grep pattern {{tenant}}
steps: Click Run, fill prompt with distinct values for each var, confirm.
expected: Single prompt lists all vars with no duplicates.
All occurrences in curl, jq, and grep are substituted with provided values.
Raw tab reruns curl using resolved variables without re-prompting.
visualChecks: No {{var}} placeholders remain in the command preview after substitution.
Prompt layout fits all inputs without overflow.

scenarios.description: Global option with --resolve applies when toggled and does not affect URL parsing.
preconditions: Add global option label "Bypass RP" argsText "--resolve 'example.com:80:192.0.2.10'".
Request URL set to https://blogs.mulesoft.ca/
steps: Edit the command textarea host from .com to .ca and verify builder fields.
expected: Command preview shows curl ... --resolve 'example.com:80:192.0.2.10' https://blogs.mulesoft.ca/ without overwriting the URL field.
Changing command text preserves URL input and global option value separately.
Run executes with both the resolve flag and the URL host from the builder.
visualChecks: Checkbox shows active state when enabled and inactive when disabled.
No duplicate --resolve entries appear.

scenarios.description: Cookie helper builds a single Cookie header while preserving user-provided headers.
preconditions: Add two cookies (one disabled, one enabled) with path/domain/samesite/secure/httpOnly variations.
Add a manual Header named Cookie: legacy=keep
steps: Toggle cookies on/off and observe command preview.
expected: Preview includes only enabled cookies in a single Cookie header; legacy header is not duplicated or removed.
Disabled cookies are omitted without deleting the manual header.
Run sends combined Cookie header with correct attributes order and separators.
visualChecks: Cookie rows wrap without overlap; datalist suggestions remain accessible.
Cookie header preview in command text updates immediately on toggle.

scenarios.description: Switching between JSON, raw, and form body modes preserves content per mode and updates curl flags correctly.
preconditions: Method POST; JSON body contains structured payload; form mode has two fields (one disabled).
steps: Enter JSON, switch to form, add fields, then switch back to JSON and to raw.
expected: Each mode retains its last state (JSON text, form fields) when revisited.
curl command uses -d/--data for JSON/raw and -F for form with only enabled fields.
Content-Type header is not auto-changed unexpectedly.
visualChecks: Textarea sizing stays consistent when switching modes.
Form table scrolls if long without breaking alignment.

scenarios.description: jq and grep run sequentially, surfaces stderr and exit codes correctly when jq fails.
preconditions: Set jq expr to invalid syntax (e.g., .data[), grep pattern foo.
steps: Inspect chain tab and stderr details.
expected: curl runs and captures output; jq fails with stderr shown and final stage indicates jq.
grep is skipped after jq failure; no stale grep output shown.
Exit code in footer reflects the failing stage.
visualChecks: Result text clearly distinguishes stdout/stderr content.
Status messages update per stage without overlap.

scenarios.description: Raw tab reruns curl only and does not reuse jq/grep output; respects variable resolution.
preconditions: Request contains variables resolved by prior Run.
jq and grep are set with expressions and patterns.
steps: Edit jq/grep inputs and switch between tabs.
expected: Raw tab reruns curl when selected if request id changed since last raw run.
Raw output ignores jq/grep and uses resolved variables without prompting again.
Changing jq/grep does not affect raw output until next chain run.
visualChecks: Tab state highlights correctly; loading indicator appears during raw rerun.
Raw tab footer shows curl stage and byte count.

scenarios.description: Kill button is enabled only while curl is active and cancels the process.
preconditions: Run a long-running curl (e.g., slow endpoint or large download).
expected: Kill enables immediately after run starts and disables as soon as curl completes or is killed.
Process is terminated; status reflects kill request and no further jq/grep steps run.
Active process id clears in UI.
visualChecks: Kill button style changes between enabled/disabled states.
No flicker or double-enabling when switching tabs.

scenarios.description: History entry restores all request fields including cookies, global options, and filters, and refreshes previews.
preconditions: Create a run with custom headers, cookies, body, global options enabled, jq expr, multiple grep patterns, and raw tab previously opened.
steps: Inspect command preview and builder fields.
expected: Builder reflects stored values and toggles; cookies list restored with enabled states.
Command preview matches the restored request; no stale command text from prior selection.
Raw tab reruns curl for the restored request instead of showing prior raw output.
visualChecks: History list selection highlights briefly on click.
No duplicate rows or missing separators in cookies.

scenarios.description: Template variables prefill defaults, run populates builder and executes once resolved.
preconditions: Template with variablesMeta default values, headers/body placeholders, and a cookie.
steps: Inspect builder and command preview; re-open modal to ensure defaults persist.
expected: Modal shows default values per variablesMeta; run substitutes and executes.
Builder fields now show concrete values and command preview has no placeholders.
Re-opening modal shows defaults again, not last-run values.
visualChecks: Modal width fits labels; buttons aligned right.
Command textarea scrolls if long without clipping.

scenarios.description: Run shortcut triggers handleRun and respects custom shortcut config.
preconditions: Set config shortcuts.runRequest to Ctrl+Alt+R in config.json or via preload fallback.
Ensure focus is inside URL input.
steps: Observe status and active process id.
expected: Run starts even when focus is in a field; status updates to Running curl...
Kill enables during curl; final output appears in chain tab.
visualChecks: No duplicate execution when holding keys briefly.
Shortcut hint in status or config is accurate.

scenarios.description: Renderer fallback config works when preload bridge is unavailable.
preconditions: Simulate missing window.shell (e.g., load renderer in standalone Vite).
steps: Open renderer in browser without Electron.
expected: App renders with fallback config; no crashes when saving or running.
Status shows Preload bridge unavailable; Run button is disabled or no-op without errors.
visualChecks: UI still lays out correctly without Electron shell.
Toolbar shows status message without overflow.

scenarios.description: Editing command textarea parses back into builder without losing headers, body, cookies, or global options.
preconditions: Build a complex request with multiple headers, cookies, body, jq, grep, and a global option enabled.
steps: Manually edit command textarea to change method and URL.
Observe builder updates; then switch fields back in UI.
Ensure command preview realigns after edits stop.
expected: Method/URL update from parsed command; headers/body/cookies remain intact.
Global option is preserved and not duplicated.
After edits stop, command preview regenerates from current state without stale fragments.
visualChecks: Flag tooltip still works when selecting curl flags after edits.
No flicker when commandDirty flips back to preview.

scenarios.description: Per-request timeout overrides default and is reflected in command and execution.
preconditions: Default timeout is 0; set request curlOptions.timeoutMs to 2000 via UI.
steps: Run against an endpoint that would exceed 2s.
expected: Command preview shows --max-time 2 (or equivalent) when timeout set.
Run aborts near 2s with timeout exit code; removing timeout allows longer run.
History captures timeout setting.
visualChecks: Timeout input (if exposed) displays value clearly; no overlap with labels.
Status mentions timeout when triggered.

scenarios.description: Multiple OR patterns with rg plus extra flags generate correct command and output.
preconditions: Enable rg; add three patterns, enable -i and -F, extra flag --no-heading.
steps: Run against JSON output with matching and non-matching lines.
Inspect final output and command preview.
expected: Preview shows rg -i -F --no-heading -e pattern1 -e pattern2 -e pattern3.
Output includes only matching lines respecting fixed strings and case-insensitive options.
Removing one pattern updates preview immediately.
visualChecks: Pattern rows align; removing middle row reorders gracefully.
Extra flags input truncates/scrolls when long.

scenarios.description: Global zoom shortcuts and narrow window preserve layout readability.
preconditions: Open app window; resize to narrow width.
steps: Use Ctrl++ then Ctrl+- then Ctrl+0 to zoom in/out/reset.
Scroll through cookies, headers, and response panels.
expected: UI scales without overlapping labels or clipped buttons; reset returns to default scale.
Scrollable areas remain usable at different zoom levels.
visualChecks: Tooltip and modal positions stay within viewport after zoom changes.
No horizontal scrollbar appears in toolbar under narrow width with zoom applied.
